Drag Out The Vote Ohio

Your stage. Your feed. Our vote.

A guide for drag artists and hosts. The ask, the lines, the graphics, the dates. Everything on this page is yours to use.

Why we are asking

Drag is the voice of our community. Friday and Saturday nights, Sunday brunch: your stage is where we gather, and for a lot of us it is church. This election decides who writes the laws we live under in Ohio. Nobody reaches our people like you do, so we are asking every queen in the state to use the mic and the feed to get our people to make a plan to vote.

The ask

  • Say it from the stage

    One line between numbers. Pick one below or say it your way.

    Jump to the lines

  • Post it

    1. Save a graphic below or make your own.
    2. Post it with your caption.
    3. Tap Invite collaborator and add @ohiopridepac so it reaches both crowds.
    Jump to the posts

  • Keep it going

    Early voting runs Oct 6 to Nov 1. Election Day is Nov 3. Every show, every week.

    Jump to the dates

Not a campaign for anyone

We are not telling anyone who to vote for, and these graphics never will. Tell your people to vote their conscience for the people they believe will show up for our community. That is the whole message.

Stage lines

Five lines, one per week. Thirty seconds between numbers.

  1. Week of Oct 5

    Before the next number. Early voting is open in Ohio. Make a plan tonight. When, where, how. Then go.

  2. Week of Oct 12

    Ohio wants a photo ID at the polls. Check your wallet now. Driver's license, state ID, passport, military ID. No ID? The BMV will give you one free.

  3. Week of Oct 19

    Voting absentee? Your request has to be at the board of elections by 8:30 pm Tuesday the 27th. Not postmarked. There.

  4. Week of Oct 26

    This is the last weekend to vote early. Saturday 8 to 4. Sunday 1 to 5. Monday is closed. Go, and take someone.

  5. Nov 2 and 3

    Tuesday. Polls open 6:30 to 7:30. If you are in line at 7:30, you vote. Vote your conscience for the people who will show up for us.

Make it yours. Say it the way you would say it. The dates are the only part that cannot change.

Posts

One graphic a week in feed and story size, with a caption to start from. Download, post, invite us as a collaborator.

  1. Week 1: Oct 5 to 11

    Early voting is open

    Caption starter

    Early voting is open in Ohio 🗳️ Make your plan tonight. When, where, how. Then go. Your county board of elections has you weekdays 8 to 5.

    https://ohiopride.org/vote

    #DragOutTheVote #OhioVotes #MakeAPlan #OhioPride

    Bring your ID

    Caption starter

    Check your wallet before you check the box 💅 Ohio needs a photo ID to vote in person. Driver's license, state ID, passport, or military ID. A free state ID is waiting at any BMV.

    Absentee by Oct 27

    #DragOutTheVote #OhioVotes #AbsenteeBallot #OhioPride

    Last weekend

    Last call for early voting 🎤 Extended hours all week. Saturday Oct 31 8 to 4. Sunday Nov 1 1 to 5. Nothing on Monday. Go this weekend and bring someone.

These are starters. Rewrite them in your voice. Keep the dates.

Three taps to add @ohiopridepac as a collaborator

  1. On the final screen before you post, tap Tag people.
  2. Tap Invite collaborator.
  3. Search ohiopridepac, tap the account, tap Done. Once we accept, the post lands on both feeds.
